dct_description_sm: This study reports a comprehensive analysis of the sedimentary record of meromictic Lake A at the northern extreme of the Canadian High Arctic. The objectives are to detail sedimentary features and related processes in the context of detailed ongoing limnological studies of the lake and to compare these features with those of other meromictic lakes in the region. This research also provides a baseline description of sedimentary characteristics for paleoenvironmental studies of Lake A and similar regional lakes.
dct_title_s: Sedimentology of Lake A, Ellesmere Island, Nunavut
